data_fields.name: balance_floor
data_fields.donor_constant: 0 (reject a change that takes a key below 0)

best_idea: One all-or-nothing batch that reads the balances under lock, checks every change against a zero floor on copies, and writes the balances and one ledger row per change in the same transaction, so a bag-to-bank gold move cannot half-apply.
decision_why: Gives the one-ledger ruling a concrete shape for gold, XP and loot moves; keep the stage-then-commit batch, drop the JSON-blob storage, throw on unknown users and sort the lock set (donor defects fixed in the sketch).
acceptance: A server test moves 50 gold from a bag holding 30: the call rejects and both balances and the ledger are unchanged; a move of 20 writes both balances and two ledger rows in one call; an unknown user throws and writes nothing.
